extension.classroom.heading: Join a class
extension.classroom.codeHelp: Six letters and numbers, from your teacher.
extension.classroom.waiting: Waiting for the teacher to begin.
extension.classroom.startSub: Students will join with the code you get next.
extension.classroom.readySub: Write this code on the board.
extension.classroom.sessionOver: The teacher has ended today's session. You can keep reading and reviewing your notes.
extension.classroom.sync.liveHint: The teacher is live. Go to their line.
extension.classroom.sync.offlineHint: The teacher is not here right now. Go to the last line.
extension.classroom.stepper.label: Move the class
extension.classroom.size.heading: Text size
extension.classroom.layout.heading: Layout
extension.classroom.view.heading: Show
extension.classroom.settings.label: Reading options
extension.classroom.toc.heading: Table of Contents
extension.classroom.view.label: Choose what to show
extension.classroom.noClasses: You are not in any classes yet. Enter the code your teacher gave you below.
extension.classroom.joinOnce: You only need the code once. After that the class stays in your list.
extension.classroom.classNameHelp: Shown in each student's list. Leave it blank to use the text's title.
extension.classroom.readyKeep: Students join once with this code, and the class stays in their list. You will find it under Your classes too.
extension.classroom.waitingForTeacher: Waiting for the teacher to arrive. You can read ahead in the meantime.
extension.classroom.sessionEndedBody: The class is still in your list, and it will be here next time.
extension.classroom.archivedBody: It is over, and has left your list.
extension.classroom.leftBody: It is still in your list, and you can rejoin it from there without the code.
extension.classroom.removedTitle: You are no longer in this class
extension.classroom.removedBody: The teacher removed you. If that was a mistake, ask them for the class code.
extension.classroom.changeCodeHelp: Everyone already in the class stays in. Anyone who has not joined yet will need the new code.
extension.classroom.removeHelp: A removed member can rejoin with the code. To keep someone out for good, remove them and then change the code.
extension.classroom.archiveHelp: For when the course is over. No one can join, and it leaves everyone's list. This cannot be undone.
extension.classroom.notes.heading: My notes
extension.classroom.notes.private: Only you can see your notes.
extension.classroom.notes.empty: Select words in the text to highlight them or add a note.
extension.classroom.notes.selectionLabel: Highlight or note the selected words
extension.classroom.dictionary.heading: Dictionary
extension.classroom.dictionary.notFound: Try selecting fewer words, or add more dictionaries.
extension.classroom.dictionary.meaningsF: Meanings from {count, plural, one {# dictionary} other {# dictionaries}}
extension.classroom.dictionary.split: Not found as a whole phrase, so shown word by word.
extension.classroom.notes.textChanged: The text here has changed, so this note can no longer be placed.
extension.classroom.leaveBody: You'll leave this class, and your notes here are kept. It stays in your list, so you can rejoin any time without the code.
extension.classroom.followHint: Your reading moves with the class
extension.classroom.haveCode: Have a code from a teacher?
extension.classroom.leaveFailed: Could not leave the class. Please try again.
extension.classroom.endSessionBody: Everyone goes back to their list of classes. The class stays, and so does everyone's place in it, so you can start again any time.
extension.classroom.endSessionHint: Send everyone back to their classes
extension.classroom.dates.heading: When the class is held
extension.classroom.dates.help: Shown to everyone in the class. It does not close the class: archiving is still up to you.
extension.classroom.dates.outOfOrder: The last day cannot be before the first day.
extension.classroom.manage.onlyYou: No one has joined yet. Share the code so students can.
extension.classroom.manage.codeChangedNo: The code is now {code}. Write the new one on the board.

extension.notFound.message: The page you're looking for is unavailable or there's an error in the URL. Please check the URL and try again.
extension.coursePartner.heroDescription: Bring your teachings online. Gather your community. Reach students everywhere.
extension.coursePartner.heading: Start your campus on WeBuddhist Academy
extension.coursePartner.introduction: Join a platform for authentic Buddhist education, connecting your teaching with students and institutions around the world.
extension.coursePartner.preservationDesc: Digitise and safeguard your lineage’s teaching so it remains available to students long after the term ends.
extension.coursePartner.reachDescription: Your courses sit alongside the work of established schools and reach practitioners on every continent.
extension.coursePartner.infrastructureDe: We provide and maintain the video hosting, structured lessons, certificates and student support your courses need.
extension.coursePartner.organizationDesc: A short description of your organization
extension.coursePartner.formError: Sorry, there was a problem submitting your request. Please try again later.
extension.coursePartner.ctaDescription: Together we can bring high-impact education to every audience — let’s build the future of dharma preservation.
